title: US and Denmark Reach New Security Deal for Greenland
subtitle: A new agreement aims to settle tensions over the Arctic territory while increasing the American military presence.

summary.en: President Trump has announced a new security deal with Denmark and Greenland regarding the Arctic island. The agreement follows months of tension after the U.S. president suggested buying the territory. While the U.S. will increase its military presence, the island will remain under Danish control. Leaders from Denmark and Greenland emphasized that the deal respects their sovereignty and right to self-determination. The pact is expected to be signed at the United Nations next week.
summary.zh: 川普總統宣布與丹麥及格陵蘭達成一項關於該北極島嶼的新安全協議。在此之前，美國總統曾暗示要購買該領土，導致雙方關係緊張數月。雖然美國將增加軍事部署，但該島仍將維持在丹麥的控制之下。丹麥與格陵蘭的領導人強調，該協議尊重其主權與自決權。此公約預計將於下週在聯合國簽署。

paragraphs.en: President Donald Trump announced on Friday that the United States has reached a new security agreement with Denmark and Greenland. This deal comes after a long period of tension, during which the U.S. president repeatedly suggested that the United States should take control of the large Arctic island. For many months, the president had even threatened to take the territory by force, causing significant worry among international allies.
paragraphs.zh: 川普 (Donald Trump) 總統週五宣布，美國已與丹麥及格陵蘭達成一項新的安全協議。在此之前，雙方經歷了長期的緊張關係，期間美國總統曾多次暗示美國應取得這座大型北極島嶼的控制權。過去幾個月裡，總統甚至威脅要以武力奪取該領土，這在國際盟友間引發了極大的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the details of the agreement are not yet fully clear, but it is expected to be signed by all three governments next week. This will happen during the United Nations General Assembly in New York City. The U.S. president described the deal as a “historic” and “special” achievement. He claimed that the agreement gives the United States permanent control over security matters in Greenland, which he believes addresses all American concerns regarding the region.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，該協議的細節尚未完全明朗，但預計將於下週由三方政府共同簽署。簽署儀式將在紐約市舉行的聯合國大會期間進行。美國總統形容這項協議是一項「歷史性」且「特殊」的成就。他聲稱，該協議賦予美國對格陵蘭安全事務的永久控制權，他認為這解決了美國對該地區的所有疑慮。

paragraphs.en: NPR reports that the deal will allow the U.S. to begin developing a larger military presence on the island. The United States already has a base at Pituffik, which has been there since the Cold War. Under the new rules, the agreement will prevent any non-NATO countries from building bases or making sensitive investments in Greenland without written approval from the United States. This is designed to stop rivals like Russia and China from gaining influence in the area.
paragraphs.zh: 美國全國公共電台 (NPR) 報導指出，這項協議將允許美國開始擴大在該島的軍事部署。美國自冷戰時期起，便在皮圖菲克 (Pituffik) 設有基地。根據新規定，未經美國書面批准，任何非北大西洋公約組織 (NATO) 的國家皆不得在格陵蘭建立基地或進行敏感投資。此舉旨在阻止俄羅斯與中國等競爭對手在該地區擴張影響力。

paragraphs.en: Despite the president’s strong language, leaders in Denmark and Greenland have a different view of the agreement. Denmark’s Prime Minister, Mette Frederiksen, stated that the deal respects the sovereignty—the right of a country to govern itself—and the territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Denmark. She also noted that the agreement supports the right of the Greenlandic people to self-determination, which means the right to decide their own political future. Greenland’s leader, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, called the agreement “joyous” and said it strengthens the security of all three parties involved.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管總統措辭強硬，但丹麥與格陵蘭的領導人對此協議有不同的看法。丹麥總理佛瑞德里克森 (Mette Frederiksen) 表示，該協議尊重丹麥王國的主權（即國家治理自身的權利）與領土完整。她也指出，該協議支持格陵蘭人民的自決權，意即決定自身政治未來的權利。格陵蘭領導人尼爾森 (Jens-Frederik Nielsen) 稱這項協議令人「欣喜」，並表示這加強了三方的安全。

paragraphs.en: This announcement is important for the U.S. government as it approaches the midterm elections in November. The president has faced criticism over a difficult war with Iran, which has become a political problem for his party. By securing this deal, the administration has a foreign policy success to show to voters. For a long time, the president had argued that owning Greenland was an “absolute necessity” for economic and national security. He even famously asked his aides to find out how the U.S. could purchase the island, comparing the idea to a large real estate deal.
paragraphs.zh: 這項宣布對美國政府而言至關重要，因為十一月的中期選舉即將到來。總統因與伊朗的艱難戰爭而面臨批評，這已成為他所屬政黨的政治難題。透過達成此協議，執政團隊得以向選民展示一項外交政策上的成功。長期以來，總統一直主張擁有格陵蘭對於經濟與國家安全是「絕對必要」的。他甚至曾名聞遐邇地要求幕僚研究美國如何買下該島，並將此構想比作一筆大型房地產交易。

paragraphs.en: However, the Danish government has consistently maintained that Greenland is not for sale. The situation became so tense last year that the Danish foreign ministry reportedly set up a “night watch” to monitor the situation. The new agreement appears to be a compromise. It avoids the president’s earlier goal of buying the island, while still giving the United States the security guarantees it wanted. The deal specifically bans any non-NATO military presence, which directly addresses the president’s concerns about Russian and Chinese influence near the island’s coastline.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，丹麥政府始終堅持格陵蘭是非賣品。去年局勢一度緊張，據報導丹麥外交部甚至設立了「夜間監控」以密切關注事態發展。這項新協議似乎是一種妥協。它避開了總統先前購買該島的目標，同時仍賦予美國所期望的安全保障。該協議明確禁止任何非北約成員國的軍事存在，這直接回應了總統對於俄羅斯與中國在該島海岸線附近影響力的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: While the agreement has been reached, it is not yet final. Both the Danish and Greenlandic governments must complete their own parliamentary procedures before the deal can be officially enforced. This means that lawmakers in these regions will have to review and approve the terms of the agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然協議已經達成，但尚未最終定案。丹麥與格陵蘭政府在協議正式生效前，必須各自完成議會程序。這意味著這些地區的立法者將必須審查並批准協議條款。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the deal marks a change in how the U.S. interacts with its Arctic allies. By focusing on a security pact rather than the forced acquisition of land, the three governments hope to move toward a more stable future. The president expressed his desire to work with the people of Denmark and Greenland, promising that the United States would be very protective of the island. As the world watches the Arctic, this agreement will likely serve as the foundation for how these nations manage the strategic territory in the coming years.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，這項協議標誌著美國與其北極盟友互動方式的轉變。透過專注於安全公約而非強行取得土地，三方政府希望邁向更穩定的未來。總統表達了與丹麥及格陵蘭人民合作的意願，並承諾美國將會極力保護該島。隨著世界目光聚焦於北極，這項協議很可能成為這些國家在未來幾年管理該戰略領土的基礎。

quiz.question: What specific restriction does the new security agreement place on non-NATO countries regarding Greenland?

options.A: They are forbidden from visiting Greenland for tourism or research.
options.B: They cannot establish military bases or make sensitive investments without U.S. written approval.
options.C: They are completely banned from entering Greenlandic territorial waters.
options.D: They must pay a tax to the U.S. government if they conduct business on the island.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，協議明確規範非北約國家若未獲得美國書面許可，不得在格陵蘭建立軍事基地或進行敏感投資。選項 A 並未提及；選項 C 誇大了限制範圍，文章僅針對軍事與敏感投資；選項 D 則完全未在文中出現，屬於無中生有的選項。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might the U.S. president have been willing to accept a security agreement instead of his original goal of buying Greenland?

options.A: He realized that Greenland was not economically valuable for the United States.
options.B: He wanted to avoid a formal war with Denmark and Greenland.
options.C: The agreement effectively addresses his primary concerns about rival influence, serving as a political success.
options.D: He was forced to change his mind by the United Nations General Assembly.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段與第六段，總統原本希望購買格陵蘭是為了國家安全，而新的協議透過禁止非北約勢力進入（第六段），成功解決了美國對俄羅斯與中國影響力的擔憂，同時也為即將到來的期中選舉提供了一個外交成就。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 B 雖有提及緊張局勢，但並非他妥協的主要動機；選項 D 則非文中提到的決策原因。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'compromise' mean in the context of the U.S.-Greenland deal?

options.A: A total surrender of one party's original demands.
options.B: An agreement reached by each side giving up some of their original demands.
options.C: A secret meeting held to discuss sensitive political information.
options.D: A legal procedure that requires parliamentary approval.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「compromise」（妥協）是指雙方各退一步以達成協議。美國放棄了「購買」格陵蘭的目標，而丹麥與格陵蘭則同意給予美國更強的區域安全保障，雙方皆有所讓步。選項 A 是「投降」；選項 C 與 D 皆非此單字的定義，屬於錯誤的語意解讀。

quiz.question: What is the primary message regarding the new security agreement between the U.S., Denmark, and Greenland?

options.A: The U.S. has successfully purchased Greenland to expand its territory.
options.B: Denmark and Greenland have rejected the U.S. proposal to maintain their independence.
options.C: The agreement marks a shift toward a security-focused partnership that addresses strategic concerns for all parties.
options.D: The agreement is a temporary measure that will likely be canceled after the U.S. midterm elections.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文旨在說明這項協議如何從原本的土地收購爭議，轉變為一個平衡各方利益的戰略安全架構。文章最後一段提到這標誌著美國與盟友互動方式的改變，並為未來的穩定奠定基礎。選項 A 與事實不符；選項 B 忽略了協議已達成的事實；選項 D 則無根據，文章並未暗示協議是暫時的。
